# Community Pages – all current listings

> Free, donation and £5-or-less activities across Greater Manchester. 749 listings, updated 31 October 2026. Source: https://communitypages.org.uk/ – please check with the organiser before going.

## Regular groups, by area

### Altrincham & Hale

Monthly book group (6 Oct, 3 Nov, 1 Dec); to join email libraries@trafford.gov.uk. https://www.trafford.gov.uk/events/altrincham-library-readers-group
